keyPoints.en: Line, shape (2D), form (3D), texture (real/implied), space (positive/negative), colour.
keyPoints.bm: Garisan, rupa (2D), bentuk (3D), jalinan (sebenar/tampak), ruang (positif/negatif), warna.

keyPoints.en: Harmony, contrast, balance (symmetrical/asymmetrical), emphasis, variety, unity, movement, rhythm and repetition.
keyPoints.bm: Harmoni, kontra, imbangan (simetri/asimetri), penegasan, kepelbagaian, kesatuan, pergerakan, ritma dan pengulangan.

tip.en: Elements = WHAT you use; principles = HOW you arrange them.
tip.bm: Unsur = APA yang digunakan; prinsip = BAGAIMANA disusun.

keyPoints.en: Show depth: smaller, higher, lighter, overlapping. Diagonal lines suggest movement.
keyPoints.bm: Tunjukkan kedalaman: lebih kecil, tinggi, cerah, bertindih. Garisan pepenjuru menunjukkan pergerakan.

keyPoints.en: Emphasis through size, position and contrast; unity keeps the work from looking messy.
keyPoints.bm: Penegasan melalui saiz, kedudukan dan kontra; kesatuan mengelakkan karya bercelaru.
